docs.title: User Guide
docs.text:
Use and administer the desk: navigation, users and permissions, customization, automation, reports, website and system administration.

Topic What it covers Desk Basics Move around the desk and work with lists, views, forms, search and collaboration tools. Users and Permissions Manage users and roles, role permissions and user permissions. Customization Change forms and fields without code, and define document workflows. Automation and Email Automate work with rules, notifications and email. Data, Reports and Printing Import and export data, run reports, build dashboards and print documents. Website and Integrations Publish web pages and web forms, and connect Frappe to other services. System Administration Configure the system, take backups and monitor logs and jobs.

docs.title: Automation and Email
docs.text:
Automate work with rules, notifications and email.

Page What it covers Automation Assign documents with Assignment Rule, repeat documents with Auto Repeat, set Reminders, track Milestones, and name documents with Document Naming Rule and Document Naming Settings. Notifications Send email, in-app, SMS or Slack alerts when documents change, with the Notification DocType, Notification Log and Notification Settings. Email Set up Email Account and Email Domain, watch the Email Queue, reuse text with Email Template, schedule Auto Email Report, and handle unsubscribes.

docs.title: Automation
docs.text: Frappe has small, rule-based tools that act on documents without code. This page covers Assignment Rule, Auto Repeat, Reminder, Milestone Tracker, Document Naming Rule and Document Naming Settings.

docs.title: Assignment Rule
docs.text:
An Assignment Rule assigns a document to a user when a condition is true. The assignment is a ToDo, the same as a manual assignment. Use it to share incoming work in a team.

  1. Go to /app/assignment-rule/new.
  2. Enter a name.
  3. Select the Document Type.
  4. Enter the Assign Condition.
  5. In Assignment Days, add the days the rule is active.
  6. Select the Rule.
  7. Add the Users.
  8. Save.

Field Description Document Type The DocType to assign. ToDo is not allowed. Priority Rules with a higher priority are tried first. Disabled Stop the rule. Description The ToDo text. Jinja with the document fields, for example {{ name }}. Default "Automatic Assignment". Assign Condition Python expression. Assign when true. Example: status == "Open". Unassign Condition Python expression. Remove the assignment made by this rule when true. Close Condition Python expression. Close the open ToDos of the document when true. Rule Round Robin, Load Balancing, Based on Field or Weighted Distribution. Users The users for Round Robin and Load Balancing. Field For Based on Field: a field that holds a user or the email address of a user. Users (weighted_users) For Weighted Distribution: users with a Weight. Due Date Based On A date field. Its value becomes the ToDo date, and the ToDo date follows it when it changes. Assignment Days The rule runs only on these weekdays.

Conditions use the document fields by name, without doc..

How the rules choose a user:

  • Round Robin: the next user in the list after the last one assigned.
  • Load Balancing: the user with the fewest open ToDos for this DocType.
  • Based on Field: the user in the selected field.
  • Weighted Distribution: users in turn, in proportion to their weight. A user with weight 2 gets two documents for each one a user with weight 1 gets.

Frappe runs the rules after each save, cancel and update after submit. It tries the unassign conditions first. It assigns only when the document has no assignment from these rules, and stops at the first rule that assigns. If an expression has an error, Frappe shows "Auto assignment failed" and saves the document.

To apply the rules to existing documents, select them in the list view and use Actions > Apply Assignment Rule.

docs.title: Auto Repeat
docs.text:
Auto Repeat makes a copy of a document on a schedule, for example a monthly order. The DocType must allow it.

  1. Open Customize Form for the DocType.
  2. Select Allow Auto Repeat and save. Frappe adds an auto_repeat field to the DocType.
  3. Open the document to repeat.
  4. Select Repeat from the menu.
  5. In the Auto Repeat dialog, select the Frequency.
  6. Enter the Start Date. End Date is optional.
  7. Click Save.

You can also create the record at /app/auto-repeat/new and select the Reference Document Type and Reference Document.

Field Description Start Date / End Date The schedule period. End Date cannot be today or the start date. Frequency Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Half-yearly or Yearly. Repeat on Days Weekdays, for Weekly. Repeat on Day / Repeat on Last Day of the Month The day of the month, for monthly and longer frequencies. Next Schedule Date The date of the next copy. Read only. Submit on Creation Submit each new copy. Only for submittable DocTypes. Notify by Email Email the Recipients with Subject and Message, or an Email Template. The email has a PDF of the new document. Print Format The print format of that PDF. Default Standard. Disabled Stop the schedule. Status Active, Disabled or Completed. Set by Frappe.

A daily job (make_auto_repeat_entry) makes the copies in the background. Each copy keeps the field values of the reference document, except fields marked No Copy. Required Date fields get the schedule date. A document can be linked to only one Auto Repeat.

docs.title: Reminder
docs.text:
A Reminder is a personal note that appears as a notification at a time you choose.

  1. Open a saved document.
  2. Select Remind Me from the menu, or press Shift+R.
  3. In Remind Me In, select 30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, 1 Day or Custom. For Custom, set Remind At.
  4. Enter a Description.
  5. Click Create.

Frappe checks reminders every 15 minutes and creates a Notification Log for the user. The time cannot be in the past. Reminders more than one hour late are not sent.

docs.title: Milestone Tracker
docs.text:
A Milestone Tracker records each change of one field, for example the status of an order. Each change makes a Milestone record with the document, the field and the new value.

  1. Go to /app/milestone-tracker/new.
  2. Select the Document Type to Track.
  3. Select the Field to Track.
  4. Save.

Open /app/milestone to see the records. Use them in reports, for example to count how many orders reached "Completed" each week.

docs.title: Document Naming Rule
docs.text:
A Document Naming Rule gives a document a name from a prefix and a counter, when the document matches conditions. Use it to name documents of one type by category, for example HW-2026-001 for hardware items.

Field Default Description Document Type The DocType to name. Prefix The name before the counter. It can use naming series parts such as .YYYY., .MM. and {fieldname}. Digits (prefix_digits) 5 The length of the counter, padded with zeros. Conditions Field, operator (=, !=, >, <, >=, <=) and value. All must match. Priority 0 Higher priority rules are tried first. Disabled 0 Stop the rule.

Frappe tries the rules before the autoname method and the DocType naming option. The first matching rule sets the name. Each rule keeps one counter in its own Counter (counter) field. The counter does not restart when the resolved prefix changes, for example from HW-2026- to HW-2027-.

Prefix: HW-.YYYY.-    Digits: 3    Condition: category = Hardware
Result: HW-2026-001

Naming rules do not apply to Single DocTypes, log DocTypes, or DocTypes with autoincrement naming. An amended document uses the rules only when its amendment naming is Default Naming.

docs.title: Document Naming Settings
docs.text:
Go to /app/document-naming-settings. This page has two parts.

Naming Series (for DocTypes that use a naming_series field):

  1. Select the DocType in Select Transaction.
  2. Edit Series List for this Transaction, one series on each line.
  3. Select User must always select to make the user pick a series.
  4. Click Update.
  5. To change a counter, select a Prefix, enter the Current Value and click Update Series Number.

Enter a series in Try a Naming Series to see a preview of the names.

Amended Documents: an amended document gets a name from the cancelled one.

Option Result Amend Counter (default) SO-00001 becomes SO-00001-1, then SO-00001-2. Default Naming The amended document gets a new name from the normal naming rules.

Set Default Amendment Naming, and override it per DocType in Amendment Naming Override.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• Assignment Rule runs from doc_events for * in frappe/hooks.py: assignment_rule.apply and assignment_rule.update_due_date.
  • Auto Repeat calls on_recurring(reference_doc, auto_repeat_doc) on the new document before insert. Define it in your controller to change the copy.
  • Set allow_auto_repeat in the DocType JSON to allow Auto Repeat without Customize Form.
  • Create a reminder from code: frappe.automation.doctype.reminder.reminder.create_new_reminder(remind_at, description, reminder_doctype=None, reminder_docname=None).
  • Add your own naming series parts with the naming_series_variables hook. See Naming.

docs.title: Related
docs.text:
• Collaboration
  • Customize Form
  • Naming

docs.title: Email
docs.text: Frappe sends and receives email through Email Accounts. Every outgoing email first goes to the Email Queue, and a scheduler job sends it. Use this page to connect a mailbox, check sent and failed emails, reuse message text, and email reports on a schedule.

docs.title: Concepts
docs.text: DocType Purpose Email Account One mailbox. It can send (SMTP), receive (IMAP or POP3), or both. Email Domain Server settings shared by all accounts of one domain. Email Queue One outgoing email and its status. Email Template A reusable subject and body with Jinja. Auto Email Report A report that Frappe emails on a schedule. Email Unsubscribe An address that does not want more email for one document, or for all email (global_unsubscribe). Communication A sent or received email linked to a document. It shows in the form timeline.

docs.title: Email Account
docs.text:
Go to /app/email-account/new.

  1. Enter the Email Address.
  2. Select a Service (GMail, Sendgrid, SparkPost, Yahoo Mail, Outlook.com or Yandex.Mail) or a Domain. Use one, not both. A service or domain fills in the server settings.
  3. Select the Method: Basic (password) or OAuth (a Connected App).
  4. Enter the password, or authorize API access for OAuth.
  5. Select Enable Outgoing, Enable Incoming, or both.
  6. Save.

docs.title: Outgoing (SMTP)
docs.text: Field Default Description Outgoing Server / Port SMTP host and port. Use TLS / Use SSL 0 Connection security. Default Outgoing 0 Send system emails and notifications from this account. Always use this email address as sender address 0 Replace the sender of every email with this address. Always use this name as sender name 0 Use the account name as the sender name. Send unsubscribe message in email 1 Add an unsubscribe link to emails sent from this account. Track Email Status 1 Track if the recipient opened the email. Disable SMTP server authentication 0 Send without login. Always BCC Address Copy every email to this address. Add Signature / Signature 0 Add a signature. Footer Content Add a footer. Brand Logo Logo for emails sent from this account.

docs.title: Incoming (IMAP or POP3)
docs.text:
Field Default Description Incoming Server / Port IMAP or POP3 host. Use IMAP 0 Use IMAP. When on, add folders in IMAP Folder. Use SSL / Use STARTTLS 0 Connection security. Append To Create or update a document of this DocType for each new email (POP3). The DocType must allow it in its settings. Default Incoming 0 Replies to system emails come to this inbox. Email Sync Option UNSEEN ALL or UNSEEN (IMAP). Initial Sync Count 250 Emails to fetch on the first sync (IMAP). Attachment Limit (MB) Skip larger attachments. Create Contacts from Incoming Emails 1 Make a Contact for new senders. Enable Automatic Linking in Documents 0 Link emails to the documents named in the recipient address. Notify if unreplied 0 Email the addresses in Send Notification to when an email has no reply after Notify if unreplied for (in mins) (default 30). Enable Auto Reply 0 Reply to every new email with Auto Reply Message. Append Emails to Sent Folder 0 Save a copy of sent emails in the IMAP sent folder (Sent Folder Name).

Frappe pulls incoming email every 10 minutes. Click Pull Emails on a saved account to pull now.

Without an Email Account record, Frappe can send email with the SMTP settings in site_config.json (mail_server, mail_port, mail_login, mail_password, use_tls, auto_email_id, email_sender_name). See Site Config.

docs.title: Email Domain
docs.text: Create an Email Domain when many accounts use the same mail server. Enter the Domain Name, the incoming and outgoing servers, ports and security options. Then select this domain in each Email Account.

docs.title: Email Queue
docs.text:
Go to /app/email-queue. Each row is one email with a status: Not Sent, Sending, Sent, Partially Sent or Error.

  • Frappe sends queued emails on every scheduler run (frappe.email.queue.flush). It takes up to 500 emails each time, highest priority first. Set email_queue_batch_size in site config to change this.
  • An email in Sending for more than 15 minutes is retried, up to the Email Retry Limit in System Settings (default 3).
  • Open an email and click Send Now to send it now. Click Retry Sending on a failed email.
  • In the list, select failed emails and use Actions > Retry Sending.
  • A System Manager can click Suspend Sending in the list to stop all sending, and Resume Sending to start again.

Emails are not sent when mute_emails is set in site config.

docs.title: Email Template
docs.text:
An Email Template holds a Subject and a Response. Both are Jinja templates. Select Use HTML to write the body as HTML code.

The document fields are available by name:

Order {{ name }} for {{ customer_name }} is ready.

Use a template in these places:

  • The email dialog of a form: select it in the Email Template field.
  • A Workflow state, in Next Action Email Template.
  • An Auto Repeat, in Template.

docs.title: Auto Email Report
docs.text:
An Auto Email Report emails the output of a report on a schedule. To create one, open a report and select Setup Auto Email from the menu, or go to /app/auto-email-report/new.

Field Default Description Report The report to send. Based on Permissions For User (user) current user Run the report as this user. Email To Addresses, one on each line. Frequency Daily, Weekdays, Weekly or Monthly. Day of Week Monday For Weekly. Format HTML, XLSX or CSV. Send only if there is any data 1 Skip empty reports. No of Rows 100 Row limit for Report Builder reports. Only Send Records Updated in Last X Hours Report Builder reports. 0 means all records. Filters Filters for Query and Script reports. From Date Field / To Date Field / Period Set date filters to the current period. Sender The Email Account to send from. Message (description) Text above the report in the email.

Click Download to get the file now, or Send Now to send it now. A user can have up to 20 enabled reports. Change this with Max auto email report per user in System Settings.

docs.title: Unsubscribe
docs.text: When Send unsubscribe message in email is on, emails get an unsubscribe link. When a recipient clicks it, Frappe creates an Email Unsubscribe record for that address and document. Frappe then skips that address for emails about the same document. A record with Global Unsubscribe skips the address for all emails.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• Send email from code with frappe.sendmail(...). It adds rows to the Email Queue. See Email and Notifications.
  • Render a template from code: frappe.get_doc("Email Template", name).get_formatted_email(doc) returns {"subject", "message"}.
  • Add your DocType to the Append To list: set email_append_to in the DocType JSON, or select Allow document creation via Email in Customize Form.
  • Scheduler jobs in frappe/hooks.py: frappe.email.queue.flush (all), email_account.pull (every 10 minutes), email_account.notify_unreplied (every 15 minutes), auto_email_report.send_daily (daily), auto_email_report.send_monthly (monthly).

docs.title: Related
docs.text:
• Notifications
  • Reports
  • System Settings
  • Form View

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text: A Notification sends a message when something happens to a document: it is created, saved, submitted, cancelled, a field changes, or a date comes near. Use it to tell people about a document without code. The message can go by email, as an in-app (system) notification, by SMS, or to a Slack channel.

docs.title: Concepts
docs.text: DocType Purpose Notification The rule: which document, which event, which condition, who gets it, and the message. Notification Log One in-app notification for one user. It shows in the bell menu in the desk. Notification Settings Per-user preferences. The name of the record is the user. Notification Type A category for in-app notifications, for example Alert. Used for filters and email preferences. Slack Webhook URL A saved Slack incoming webhook for the Slack channel.

docs.title: Create a notification
docs.text:
1. Go to /app/notification/new.
  2. Optional: enter a name. If you do not, Frappe uses the subject as the name.
  3. Make sure that Enabled is set. It is set by default.
  4. Select the Channel.
  5. Enter the Subject.
  6. Select Send Alert On.
  7. Select the Document Type.
  8. Optional: add a Condition.
  9. Add rows in Recipients.
  10. Enter the Message.
  11. Save.

For the Days Before and Days After events, a saved notification shows Get Alerts for Today. It lists the documents that would get the alert today.

docs.title: Channels
docs.text:
Channel Sends Needs Email An email through the Email Queue. An outgoing Email Account. Optional Sender. Slack The rendered message to a Slack channel. A Slack Channel (slack_webhook_url), a Slack Webhook URL record. System Notification A Notification Log for each recipient user. Recipients that resolve to users. SMS A text message through the SMS gateway. SMS settings and recipients with a mobile number.

For the other channels, select Send System Notification to also create an in-app notification. Set Notification Title and Notification Message for it.

docs.title: Slack Webhook URL
docs.text:
1. Make an incoming webhook in your Slack workspace.
  2. Go to /app/slack-webhook-url/new.
  3. Enter Name (webhook_name) and Webhook URL (webhook_url).
  4. Optional: set Show link to document to add a "Go to the document" button to the message.
  5. Save.
  6. Select the record in Slack Channel on the Notification.

docs.title: Events
docs.text:
Send Alert On When it runs New After a document is inserted (after_insert). Save After every save (on_update). Submit After submit (on_submit). Cancel After cancel (on_cancel). Value Change After save, when the field in Value Changed has a new value. Not on insert. Method When the controller method in Trigger Method runs, for example before_insert. Days Before / Days After Once a day, for documents whose Reference Date field is the given number of days from today. Custom Never on its own. Code sends it, for example with notification.send(doc).

Date-based events also work on child table DocTypes. Other events do not. You cannot create a notification on Email Queue.

docs.title: Conditions
docs.text:
Condition is an optional Python expression. The notification is sent only when it is true. The expression gets doc, nowdate and a frappe object with frappe.utils only.

doc.status == "Open" and doc.total > 500

docs.title: Recipients
docs.text:
Each row in Recipients can add people in these ways:

Field Description Receiver By Document Field owner, or a field of the document (or of a child table) that holds a user, an email address or a mobile number. Receiver By Role All users with this role. CC / BCC Email addresses, one on each line. Jinja is allowed. Email channel only. Condition A Python expression. The row is used only when it is true.

Select Send To All Assignees to also email every user the document is assigned to (Email channel).

docs.title: Message
docs.text:
Subject and Message are Jinja templates. The context has doc, alert (the Notification) and comments (the latest comments on the document). Frappe renders them with restricted globals.

<h3>Order {{ doc.name }}</h3>
<p>{{ doc.customer_name }} placed an order of {{ doc.total }}.</p>

Other options:

Field Description Attach Print / Print Format Attach a PDF of the document. Attach Files / From Attach Field From Field (one Attach field) or All (all attachments). Set Property After Alert / Value To Be Set Set a field on the document after the notification is sent. Notification Type The type of the in-app notification. Default Alert.

docs.title: Notification Log and the bell menu
docs.text:
Each in-app notification is a Notification Log for one user (for_user). The bell icon in the desk lists them. A user can only read their own logs. Frappe does not create a log when the recipient is the user who made the change, except for types in the notification_self_notify_types hook (Alert and Energy Point in Frappe).

When a log is created, Frappe also emails it to the user if the user has email notifications on for that type. Types in the notification_skip_email_types hook (Alert in Frappe) do not send this extra email, because the Notification rule sends its own email.

docs.title: Notification Settings
docs.text:
Each user can open their settings from the gear icon in the bell menu, or at /app/notification-settings/<user>.

Field Default Description Enable System Notification (enabled) 1 Turn off all in-app notifications for this user. Enable Email Notifications 1 Receive notification emails. Email me for these notification types Types that send an email. Mentions / Assignments / Energy Points / Document Share / Event Reminders 1 Email for these events. Email Threads on Assigned Document 1 Email when a reply arrives on a document assigned to you. Energy Points (energy_points_system_notifications) 1 In-app notifications for energy points. Open Documents (subscribed_documents) DocTypes to follow in the notifications panel.

docs.title: Pitfalls
docs.text:
• Notifications do not run during data import with emails muted, during patches, or during install.
  • If the Value Changed field is removed from the DocType, Frappe disables the notification and logs an error.
  • A Standard notification (is_standard) can only be edited in developer mode. To change one, disable it and duplicate it.
  • An error in the template stops the save that triggered it, with "Error in Notification".
  • An error while sending, for example a Slack request that fails, does not stop the save. Frappe logs "Failed to send Notification" in the Error Log.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• Ship a notification with an app: set Is Standard and a Module in developer mode. Frappe exports it to <module>/notification/<name>/ with the JSON, the message file (.md, .html or .txt by Message Type) and a .py file with get_context(context).
  • Send a notification from code: frappe.get_doc("Notification", name).send(doc). It sends at once and does not check Condition.
  • trigger_daily_alerts runs daily from scheduler_events in frappe/hooks.py.
  • Create an in-app notification from code with enqueue_create_notification(users, doc_dict) in frappe/desk/doctype/notification_log/notification_log.py.
  • See Email and Notifications for the developer guide.

docs.title: Related
docs.text:
• Email
  • Workflow
  • Automation
  • Collaboration

docs.title: Desk Basics
docs.text:
Move around the desk and work with lists, views, forms, search and collaboration tools.

Page What it covers Desk Find your way around the Frappe v15 desk at /app - login, navbar, workspace sidebar, workspaces, awesomebar, notifications, user menu and keyboard shortcuts. List View Find, filter, sort and select documents in the Frappe v15 list view, use the group-by sidebar and saved filters, run bulk actions and set list settings. Views Show the documents of a DocType in Frappe v15 as a report, kanban board, calendar, gantt chart, tree, dashboard, image grid, map or email inbox. Form View Read and change one document in the Frappe v15 desk form - layout, save, submit, cancel and amend, timeline, attachments, sharing, print, email, links, duplicate, rename and form shortcuts. Search Find pages and documents in Frappe v15 with the awesomebar, global search, list filters and tags, and control what global search indexes. Collaboration Work on documents with other users in Frappe v15 - assignments and ToDo, sharing, comments and mentions, likes, follow, tags, energy points, activity and the notification log.

docs.title: Collaboration
docs.text: The desk has tools to work on documents with other users. Assign a document to a user, share it, comment on it, mention users, follow it, tag it and give energy points. Each action can send a notification. Most tools are in the form sidebar and timeline. Some also work on many documents from the list view.

docs.title: Assignments
docs.text:
An assignment gives a document to a user as a task. Each assignment is a ToDo document for that user.

To assign a document:

  1. Open the document.
  2. In the sidebar, click + next to Assigned To.
  3. In Assign To, select one or more users. Select Assign to me to add yourself. Select a user group in Assign To User Group to add all its users.
  4. Optional: set Complete By, Priority (Low, Medium or High) and a Comment.
  5. Click Add.

To assign many documents, select them in the list view and click Actions > Assign To.

When you assign a document, Frappe:

  • Creates a ToDo with allocated_to, reference_type, reference_name, description, priority and date. The default description is "Assignment for ".
  • Adds the user to the _assign field of the document. The list view shows the user's avatar on the row.
  • Shares the document with the user (read only) if the user cannot read it. If document sharing is turned off in System Settings, it shows an error.
  • Sends an Assignment notification to the user.
  • Makes the user follow the document if Auto follow documents that are assigned to you is on for the user.

    • If the user already has an open ToDo for the document, Frappe does not make a second one.

    Click the assigned users under Assigned To to open the assignments dialog. In this dialog:

    • Click the check icon (Done) next to your own assignment to complete it. This sets the ToDo to Closed. Only the assignee can do this.
    • Click the cross icon (Cancel) to remove an assignment. You can remove your own assignment, or any assignment if you can write the document. This sets the ToDo to Cancelled.

    In the list view, Actions > Clear Assignment removes all assignments of the selected documents.

docs.title: The ToDo list
docs.text:
Open the ToDo list to see your assignments. A user without a ToDo role permission sees only ToDos allocated to, assigned by or created by them.

Calendar and Kanban views are also available for ToDo. Refer to Views.

For developers

Assign from code with frappe.desk.form.assign_to.add({"assign_to": ["user1@example.com"], "doctype": "Sample Order", "name": "SO-00001", "description": "Check the items"}). Remove with frappe.desk.form.assign_to.remove(doctype, name, assign_to). If the DocType has a field named assigned_to, Frappe also sets it. Use an Assignment Rule to assign documents automatically.

docs.title: Sharing
docs.text:
Sharing gives one user access to one document, even if the user's role has no access to the DocType.

  1. Open the document.
  2. In the sidebar, click + next to Share.
  3. Under Share this document with, select a user.
  4. Select the rights: Can Read, Can Write, Can Submit and Can Share.
  5. Click Add.

Use the Everyone row to share the document with all users. You can share only if you have the share right on the document. The user gets a Share notification.

Each share is a DocShare document. A System Manager can turn off sharing for the site in System Settings (disable_document_sharing).

For developers

Share from code with frappe.share.add(doctype, name, user, read=1, write=0, submit=0, share=0, everyone=0, notify=0). Read shares with frappe.share.get_users(doctype, name). Refer to Permissions.

docs.title: Comments and mentions
docs.text:
Every user who can read a document can comment on it.

  1. Type in the comment box below the form.
  2. To mention a user, type @ and select the user.
  3. Click Comment.

The comment shows in the activity of the document. You can edit your own comments. Administrator can edit all comments. The comment owner and a System Manager can also delete (if they can delete Comment) and publish or unpublish a comment.

A mentioned user gets a Mention notification. A user gets mentions only if Allowed In Mentions is on for the user and the user is an enabled System User.

For developers

A comment is a Comment document with comment_type = Comment. The desk calls frappe.desk.form.utils.add_comment. Mentions are handled by frappe.desk.notifications.notify_mentions.

docs.title: Likes
docs.text: Click the heart in the form sidebar or on a list row to like a document. Click it again to remove the like. The list view header has a heart that shows only the documents you liked. Likes are stored in the _liked_by field and show in the activity.

docs.title: Follow
docs.text:
Follow a document to get emails about its changes.

  1. Turn on Send Notifications For Documents Followed By Me in your User, in the Document Follow section.
  2. Select a Frequency: Hourly, Daily or Weekly.
  3. Open a document and click Follow in the form sidebar.

The Follow link shows on every form, but a follow is saved only for DocTypes with Track Changes, and only for users who turned on step 1. Administrator cannot follow documents. Each follow is a Document Follow document. Click Unfollow to stop.

You can also follow documents automatically. Turn on these options in your User:

  • Auto follow documents that you create
  • Auto follow documents that you comment on
  • Auto follow documents that you Like
  • Auto follow documents that are shared with you
  • Auto follow documents that are assigned to you

For developers

The scheduler sends the follow emails with frappe.desk.form.document_follow.send_hourly_updates, send_daily_updates and send_weekly_updates. Follow from code with frappe.desk.form.document_follow.follow_document(doctype, doc_name, user).

docs.title: Tags
docs.text:
A tag is a label on a document, for example urgent.

  • In the form sidebar, click + next to Tags and type a tag.
  • In the list view, select documents and click Actions > Add Tags.

To find tagged documents, type # and the tag in the awesomebar, or use the Tags dropdown in the list sidebar. To show tags on list rows, click Show Tags in the list sidebar.

Tags are stored in the _user_tags column of the document, and in Tag and Tag Link documents.

docs.title: Energy points
docs.text: Energy points reward users for work on documents. Rules give points automatically. Users with review points can also give or take points by hand. Energy points are off by default.

docs.title: Turn on energy points
docs.text:
1. Open Energy Point Settings.
  2. Select Enabled.
  3. Optional: add rows to Review Levels. Each row has a Level Name, a Role and Review Points.
  4. Set Point Allocation Periodicity: Daily, Weekly (default) or Monthly.
  5. Save.

A daily job (allocate_review_points) gives each user with a review level role the Review Points of that level, once per period. A user with more than one level gets the highest value. Administrator gets no review points.

docs.title: Energy Point Rule
docs.text:
An Energy Point Rule gives points when a document event happens. Only a System Manager can make rules.

Field Label Description enabled Enabled Default 1. rule_name Rule Name The name of the rule. Required. reference_doctype Reference Document Type The DocType to watch. Required. for_doc_event For Document Event New, Submit, Cancel, Value Change or Custom (default). field_to_check Field To Check For Value Change: the field that must change. condition Condition For Custom and Value Change: a Python expression on doc, for example doc.status == "Closed". points Points Points to give. Required. user_field User Field The field that holds the user who gets the points, for example owner_user. for_assigned_users Allot Points To Assigned Users Gives the points to all assigned users in place of the user field. Not for New. multiplier_field Multiplier Field A number field. Points are multiplied by its value. max_points Maximum Points The upper limit when a multiplier is set. apply_only_once Apply Only Once Gives points only once per document and user.

Rules run on the on_change event of every document (doc_events in frappe/hooks.py), but not during install, migrate, patches or data import. Administrator and disabled users get no points. When a submitted document is cancelled, Frappe reverts the Auto points of that document.

You cannot delete a rule that has logs. Clear Enabled instead.

docs.title: Energy Point Log
docs.text:
Each change of points is an Energy Point Log document with user, type, points, reason, rule, reference_doctype and reference_name. The types are:

Type Made by Auto An Energy Point Rule. Appreciation A user who gives review points. Adds points. Criticism A user who gives review points. Removes points. Review The review point allocation, or the use of review points. Revert A System Manager who reverts an Auto log, or the cancel of a submitted document.

The user gets an Energy Point notification for each log, except Review logs. Weekly and monthly summary emails are sent by scheduled jobs.

docs.title: Review a document
docs.text:
When energy points are on, a saved form shows Reviews in the sidebar.

  1. Click + next to Reviews.
  2. In To User, select a user. Only users involved in the document are listed.
  3. In Action, select Appreciate or Criticize.
  4. Type the Points and a Reason.
  5. Click Submit.

The points come from your review points. If you do not have enough review points, Frappe shows a message and makes no log.

docs.title: Leaderboard
docs.text:
Open /app/leaderboard to see the users with the most energy points. Select a Timespan, for example This Week, This Month or All Time. The User leaderboard sums the energy points of enabled System Users, without Review logs.

For developers

Add leaderboards with the leaderboards hook. It points to a function that returns a dict keyed by DocType, for example {"User": {"fields": ["points"], "method": "frappe.desk.leaderboard.get_energy_point_leaderboard", "company_disabled": 1, "icon": "users"}}. Read a user's points with frappe.social.doctype.energy_point_log.energy_point_log.get_energy_points(user). It returns energy_points, review_points and given_points.

docs.title: Activity
docs.text: The Activity section of a form shows the history of the document: creation, changes, attachments, likes, assignments, emails and comments. Field changes show only if the DocType has Track Changes. Refer to Form view.

docs.title: Notification log
docs.text:
Each notification for a user is a Notification Log document. The notification types are Alert, Share, Assignment, Mention and Energy Point (DocType Notification Type).

To read notifications:

  1. Click the bell in the navbar.
  2. Click a notification to open the document. This marks it as read.
  3. Click the check icon to mark all as read.
  4. Click View Full Log to open the Notification Log list.

docs.title: Notification settings
docs.text:
Click the gear icon in the notifications panel to open your Notification Settings.

Field Label Default What it does enabled Enable System Notification 1 Shows notifications in the desk. enable_email_notifications Enable Email Notifications 1 Also sends notifications by email. enable_email_mention Mentions 1 Emails for mentions. enable_email_assignment Assignments 1 Emails for assignments. enable_email_energy_point Energy Points 1 Emails for energy points. enable_email_share Document Share 1 Emails for shares. enable_email_event_reminders Event Reminders 1 Emails for event reminders. enable_email_threads_on_assigned_document Email Threads on Assigned Document 1 Emails for email threads on documents assigned to you. energy_points_system_notifications Energy Points 1 Shows energy point notifications in the desk.

Refer to Notifications to send your own notifications with the Notification DocType.

docs.title: Related
docs.text:
• Form view
  • List view
  • Notifications
  • Automation
  • Permissions
  • Email

docs.title: Desk
docs.text:
The desk is the back-office user interface of a Frappe site. System Users use it to read, create and change documents. It opens at /app. Use this page to learn the parts of the desk screen and how to move between them.

Version

In Frappe v16, the desk moved to /desk and has a dock. In v15, /desk redirects to /app.

docs.title: Log in
docs.text:
1. Open <site>/login in the browser.
  2. Type your email (or username) and password.
  3. Click Login.

After login, a System User goes to the desk. LoginManager.set_user_info in frappe/auth.py picks the target:

  1. If the user has a Default Workspace (default_workspace), go to /app/<workspace>.
  2. Else, if a default app is set, go to the route of that app (get_default_path() in frappe/apps.py).
  3. Else, go to /app.

A Website User does not get desk access and goes to the website instead.

docs.title: Desk layout
docs.text:
The desk screen has a navbar at the top, a sidebar on the left and the page in the main area.

Part Where What it does Navbar Top The logo (goes home), breadcrumbs, the awesomebar, the notification bell, the Help menu and your avatar. Sidebar Left On a workspace: the list of workspaces. On a list or form: the list or form sidebar. Page Main area Shows the workspace, list, form, report or page that you opened.

Click the menu icon next to the page title to hide or show the sidebar.

docs.title: Workspaces
docs.text:
A workspace is a page with shortcuts, link cards, charts, number cards and other blocks. The sidebar lists the workspaces in two groups:

  • Public: workspaces for all users.
  • Personal: your private workspaces.

A workspace with a parent shows nested under its parent. Click a workspace to open it, for example /app/build.

When you open /app, the desk shows, in this order: your Default Workspace, the last workspace you opened, or the first workspace in the sidebar.

The buttons at the bottom of a workspace are:

Button What it does Edit Makes the blocks editable. Add blocks, drag them to move them, then click Save or Discard. New Opens the New Workspace dialog: Title, Parent, Public, Icon and Indicator color.

In edit mode, each workspace in the sidebar has a settings menu with Edit, Duplicate, Hide and Delete. Only a user with the Workspace Manager role can edit, sort or make a public workspace. Other users can edit their personal workspaces and duplicate public ones.

docs.title: Apps screen
docs.text:
The page /apps shows one tile for each installed app that sets the add_to_apps_screen hook. Open it from Apps in the user menu. Frappe itself has no tile. On a site with only Frappe installed, /apps redirects to /app.

For developers

An app adds its tile with the add_to_apps_screen hook in hooks.py (keys name, logo, title, route, has_permission). See Workspaces and sidebar.

docs.title: Search
docs.text: Click the search box in the navbar, or press Ctrl+G, to open the awesomebar. Type a DocType name, a report name or new <DocType>. Refer to Search.

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text:
Click the bell in the navbar to open the notifications panel. The bell shows a mark when you have unread notifications.

The panel has three tabs:

  • Notifications: your notifications, for example assignments, mentions, shares and energy points.
  • Events: your upcoming events.
  • What's New: items from the changelog feed (Changelog Feed).

At the top of the panel, click the gear icon to open your Notification Settings. Click the check icon to mark all notifications as read. Click View Full Log to open the Notification Log list. Refer to Collaboration.

docs.title: Help menu
docs.text: Click Help in the navbar. The default items are About, Keyboard Shortcuts and Frappe Support. A System Manager changes these items in Navbar Settings.

docs.title: User menu
docs.text:
Click your avatar at the right of the navbar.

Item What it does My Profile Opens your user profile page (/app/user-profile). My Settings Opens your User form. Session Defaults Sets default values, for example a default company, for this session. Reload Clears the cache and reloads the desk. View Website Opens the website home page. Apps Opens the apps screen at /apps. Toggle Full Width Changes the page between fixed width and full width. Toggle Theme Opens the theme switcher (Light, Dark or Automatic). Log out Logs you out.

A System Manager changes these items in Navbar Settings.

docs.title: Desk settings of a user
docs.text:
These fields on the User DocType change the desk for one user. A System Manager sets them in the Settings tab of the User form, in the sections Desk Settings, Navigation Settings, List Settings and Form Settings.

Field Label Default Effect desk_theme Desk Theme none Light, Dark or Automatic. mute_sounds Mute Sounds 0 Turns off desk sounds. search_bar Search Bar 1 Shows the awesomebar. notifications Notifications 1 Shows the notification bell. list_sidebar Sidebar (List Settings) 1 Shows the sidebar in list views. bulk_actions Bulk Actions 1 The desk in this version does not read this field. view_switcher View Switcher 1 Shows the view switcher in list views. form_sidebar Sidebar (Form Settings) 1 Shows the sidebar in forms. form_navigation_buttons Navigation Buttons 1 Shows the previous and next buttons in forms. timeline Timeline 1 Shows the activity timeline in forms. dashboard Dashboard 1 Shows the connections dashboard in forms.

The desk reads these values at boot (get_desk_settings() in frappe/boot.py). Reload the desk after a change.

docs.title: Keyboard shortcuts
docs.text:
Press Shift+/ (the ? key), or select Help > Keyboard Shortcuts, to see the shortcuts for the current page. On macOS, Cmd works in place of Ctrl.

These shortcuts work on every desk page:

Shortcut Action Ctrl+S Do the primary action of the page, for example Save. Ctrl+G Open the awesomebar. Ctrl+H Go to the desk home. Alt+S Open the user menu. Alt+H Open the Help menu. Shift+/ Show keyboard shortcuts. Ctrl+Shift+R Clear cache and reload. Ctrl+Shift+G Switch theme. Esc Close the open dialog or the open child table row.

On a workspace page, type any letter to open the awesomebar with that letter.

Hold Alt to see underlined letters in menus and the sidebar. Press Alt and the letter to click that item.

Shortcuts for lists and forms are on List view and Form view.

For developers

Add a shortcut with frappe.ui.keys.add_shortcut({shortcut, action, description, page, condition, ignore_inputs}) (frappe/public/js/frappe/ui/keyboard.js). Pass page to limit the shortcut to one page. Only shortcuts with a description show in the dialog. A menu item gets a shortcut through the shortcut argument of page.add_menu_item().

docs.title: Related
docs.text:
• List view
  • Form view
  • Search
  • Collaboration
  • Workspaces and sidebar

docs.title: Form View
docs.text: The form view shows one document. Use it to read, change, save and submit the document, and to work with other users on it. Open a form from the list view, or at /app/<doctype-slug>/<name>, for example /app/sample-order/SO-00001. For a new document, click Add in the list view or press Ctrl+B on a form.

docs.title: Parts of the form
docs.text: Part What it shows Title bar The document title and a status indicator, for example Draft or Not Saved. The breadcrumbs in the navbar show the DocType and the name. Print icon Opens the print view. Previous and next buttons Open the previous or next document of the list. Turn them off with Navigation Buttons on your User. ... menu More actions. Refer to Form menu. Primary button The next action, for example Save, Submit, Update, Cancel or Amend. Fields The fields of the document in tabs, sections and columns. Sidebar Assigned To, Attachments, Tags, Share, likes, comment count, Follow, and who created and last changed the document. Comments and Activity The comment box and the timeline.

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
The DocType defines the layout with layout fields:

  • A Tab Break starts a tab. The tabs show at the top of the form.
  • A Section Break starts a section. A section can have a label. A collapsible section opens when you click its label.
  • A Column Break starts a new column in the section.

A Table field shows a child table, for example Items in Sample Order. Click Add Row to add a row. Click the edit icon at the end of a row to open the row as a form. The table can also have Add Multiple, Download and Upload buttons.

Hold Alt and move the pointer over a field to see its fieldname. Click to copy the fieldname.

To change the page width, select Toggle Full Width in the user menu.

docs.title: Save, submit, cancel and amend
docs.text:
Each document has a docstatus:

docstatus Status Can you edit it? 0 Draft Yes. 1 Submitted Only fields with Allow on Submit. 2 Cancelled No.

A normal DocType has only drafts. Click Save or press Ctrl+S to save. If a mandatory field is empty, a Missing Fields message lists the fields.

A submittable DocType (Is Submittable set) has the full cycle:

  1. Click Save. The document is a draft. A message says Submit this document to confirm.
  2. Click Submit. Confirm Permanently Submit SO-00001?. The document is now submitted.
  3. To change an Allow on Submit field, change it and click Update.
  4. To stop a submitted document, click Cancel. Confirm Permanently Cancel SO-00001?.
  5. To fix a cancelled document, click Amend. A new draft opens with Amended From set.

When you cancel a document that other submitted documents link to, the Cancel All Documents dialog lists them. Click Cancel All to cancel them together.

By default, an amended document gets the name of the original with a counter, for example SO-00001-1. Change this in Document Naming Settings with Default Amendment Naming (Amend Counter or Default Naming) or Amendment Naming Override for one DocType.

The buttons need permissions: Submit needs the submit right, Cancel the cancel right, and Amend the amend right. If the DocType has a workflow, the workflow actions replace Submit.

docs.title: Comments and activity
docs.text:
Below the fields, the form shows:

  • Comments: type in the box and click Comment. Type @ to mention a user. Refer to Collaboration.
  • Activity: a timeline of events. It shows who created and changed the document, attachments, likes, assignments, emails and comments. If the DocType has Track Changes, it also shows each field change.
  • New Email: writes an email about the document. The email shows in the timeline.

Turn off the timeline for your user with Timeline (timeline).

docs.title: Sidebar
docs.text:
Item What it does Assigned To Click + to assign the document to users. Refer to Collaboration. Attachments Click + to upload a file or add a link. Max Attachments on the DocType sets a limit. Tags Click + to add tags. Share Click + to share the document with users. Heart Likes the document. Comment count The number of comments. Follow / Unfollow Follows the document. Refer to Collaboration. Reviews Click + to give or take energy points for the document. Shows only when energy points are on. Refer to Collaboration.

Turn off the sidebar for your user with Sidebar (form_sidebar) in the Form Settings section of the User. Click the menu icon next to the title to hide or show it.

docs.title: Connections
docs.text:
If other DocTypes link to this DocType, the form shows a Connections section with the linked document counts. Click a DocType to open its list with a filter for this document. Click + to create a linked document. Turn it off for your user with Dashboard (dashboard).

Select Links in the menu to see all documents that link to this one.

docs.title: Form menu
docs.text:
Click ... in the title bar. The menu shows only the items that apply.

Item Shortcut What it does Print Ctrl+P Opens the print view. For a submittable DocType, drafts and cancelled documents print only if Print Settings allow it. Refer to Printing. Email Ctrl+E Opens the email composer. Not for cancelled documents. Jump to field Ctrl+J Finds a field and moves to it. Links Lists the documents that link to this document. Duplicate Shift+D Opens a new document with the same values. Hidden if Hide Copy is set on the DocType. Copy to Clipboard Copies the document as JSON. Rename Changes the name of the document. Needs Allow Rename on the DocType and write permission. Reload Loads the document again. Delete Ctrl+Shift+D Deletes the document. Not for submitted documents. Remind Me Shift+R Sets a reminder for this document. Undo / Redo Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y Undoes or redoes a field change. Customize Opens Customize Form. Edit DocType Opens the DocType. Only in developer mode. Repeat Creates an Auto Repeat. Needs Allow Auto Repeat on the DocType. New Sample Order Ctrl+B Opens a new document of this DocType.

docs.title: Rename
docs.text:
1. Click the title in the title bar, or select Rename in the menu.
  2. Change the title, the name or both.
  3. To merge this document into an existing document with that name, select Merge with existing.
  4. Click Rename.

The rename also changes the links in other documents. A rename can run in the background. A message tells you when it is queued.

docs.title: Keyboard shortcuts
docs.text:
Shortcut Action Ctrl+S Save, or do the primary action. Ctrl+Shift+> Go to the next record. Ctrl+Shift+< Go to the previous record. Ctrl+P Print. Ctrl+E Email. Ctrl+J Jump to field. Ctrl+B New document. Shift+D Duplicate. Ctrl+Shift+D Delete. Shift+R Remind me. Ctrl+Z Undo. Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z Redo. Alt + pointer on a field Show the fieldname. Click to copy it.

In a child table:

Shortcut Action Up / Down Move to the row above or below. Tab / Shift+Tab Move to the next or previous column. Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down Add a row above or below the current row. Ctrl+Shift+Up / Ctrl+Shift+Down Add a row at the top or at the bottom. Shift+Alt+Down Duplicate the current row. Esc Close the open row.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• Form behavior comes from <doctype>.js with frappe.ui.form.on("Sample Order", {...}). Other apps add form scripts with the doctype_js hook. Refer to Form scripts.
  • Add a menu item with frm.page.add_menu_item(label, action, standard, shortcut) and a button with frm.add_custom_button().
  • The DocType properties is_submittable, allow_rename, allow_copy (Hide Copy), track_changes, max_attachments, allow_auto_repeat and image_field control the items above. Refer to DocTypes.
  • The Connections section comes from the links table of the DocType and from get_data() in <doctype>_dashboard.py (Meta.get_dashboard_data in frappe/model/meta.py). Other apps change it with the override_doctype_dashboards hook.
  • The server runs before_submit, on_submit, before_cancel and on_cancel on the controller. Refer to Controllers.

docs.text:
• List view
  • Collaboration
  • Printing
  • Workflow
  • Form scripts
  • Controllers

docs.title: List View
docs.text: The list view shows the documents of one DocType as rows. Use it to find documents, filter and sort them, and change many documents at the same time. Open it from a workspace, from the awesomebar, or at /app/<doctype-slug>, for example /app/sample-order.

docs.title: Parts of the list view
docs.text:
Part What it shows Title The DocType name, for example Sample Order. Click the menu icon next to it to hide or show the sidebar. View switcher (List View) Changes to another view. Refer to Views. Reload button Loads the list again. ... menu List and DocType settings. Refer to List menu. Add Sample Order Creates a document. Sidebar Filter By (group-by counts), Tags, Show Tags and Save Filter. Standard filters Fields above the rows, for example ID, Customer Name and Status. Filter Adds filters on any field. The x next to it removes all filters. Sort button Sets the sort field and the sort order. Rows One row for each document. The right side of the row shows the assigned users, the time of the last change, the comment count and a heart (like). Count For example 6 of 6: rows loaded and total rows that match the filters. Page size 20, 100, 500 or 2500 rows.

Click the title of a row to open the document in the form view.

docs.title: Standard filters
docs.text:
Standard filters show above the list. Type or select a value to filter at once. These fields show as standard filters:

  • ID (name), unless the list settings set hide_name_filter.
  • The title field of the DocType.
  • Fields with In Standard Filter (in_standard_filter) checked.

The ID filter and text fields match a part of the value (like). Select and Link fields match the exact value. A Link to a tree DocType matches the value and its descendants.

docs.title: Filter button
docs.text:
1. Click Filter.
  2. Select a field, a condition (for example Equals) and a value.
  3. To add one more condition, click + Add a Filter.
  4. To remove all conditions, click Clear Filters, or the x next to Filter.

You can also click a value in a row, for example a status indicator, to filter by that value.

Filters show in the URL as query parameters, for example /app/sample-order?status=Open. Share the URL to share the filtered list. The desk also remembers your last filters for each DocType.

Large tables

The desk treats a table as large when it has more than 100,000 rows (estimated) and a document was modified in the last 30 days. On a large table with no filters, the list adds a filter for documents modified in the last 90 days. A message tells you about it. Turn this off with Disable Automatic Recency Filters in List settings.

docs.title: Sidebar
docs.text: The list sidebar shows under the title. Turn it off for a user with Sidebar (list_sidebar) in the user's List Settings section.

docs.title: Filter By
docs.text:
Filter By has a dropdown for Assigned To and Created By. Each dropdown lists the values with the number of matching documents. Click a value to filter by it. Me stands for you.

To add more group-by fields:

  1. Click Edit Filters.
  2. In Select Filters, select the fields. Fields of type Select, Link, Data, Int and Check are listed.
  3. Click Save.

The selected fields are saved in your user settings for this DocType (group_by_fields). The counts come from frappe.desk.listview.get_group_by_count.

docs.title: Tags
docs.text: The Tags dropdown lists the tags of the DocType with counts. Click a tag to filter by it. Click Show Tags to show the tags of each document in its row.

docs.title: Saved filters
docs.text:
Save the current filters with a name:

  1. Set the filters.
  2. Under Save Filter, type a Filter Name.
  3. Select Is Global to share the filter with all users.
  4. Press Enter.

Click Show Saved to see the saved filters. Click a filter to apply it. Click the x on a filter to delete it. Saved filters are List Filter documents (reference_doctype, filter_name, for_user, filters). A global filter has no for_user.

docs.title: Sort
docs.text:
Click the field name on the sort button to select the sort field. Click the icon on its left to change between ascending and descending order.

The sort options are Last Updated On, ID, Created On, Most Used (idx), the title field, the default sort field of the DocType, and every field that is mandatory, bold or in the list view. The default sort is the Default Sort Field and Default Sort Order of the DocType. A new DocType sorts by modified.

docs.title: Select rows and run bulk actions
docs.text:
Select the check box of a row to select it. Select the check box in the header to select all loaded rows. When you select rows, the Add button changes to Actions.

Action Shows when What it does Edit The DocType has editable fields Sets one field to one value on all selected documents. Export Always Exports the selected rows. Assign To Always Assigns the documents to users. Refer to Collaboration. Clear Assignment Always Removes all assignments. Apply Assignment Rule Always Runs the assignment rules on the documents. Add Tags Always Adds tags to the documents. Print You can print the DocType Prints all selected documents in one PDF. Submit Submittable DocType, you can submit, no workflow Submits the documents. Cancel You can cancel, no workflow Cancels the documents. Delete You can delete Deletes the documents after you confirm.

If the DocType has a workflow, Edit and Delete need Allow Bulk Editing in list settings.

Large jobs run in the background:

Action Runs in the background when Edit, Submit, Cancel 20 or more documents. More than 500 documents is not allowed. Delete More than 10 documents.

docs.title: Like, comments and assignments in rows
docs.text:
• Click the heart on a row to like the document. Click the heart in the header to show only documents that you liked.
  • The comment icon shows the number of comments.
  • The avatars show the assigned users.

docs.title: Paging and refresh
docs.text:
The list loads 20 rows. On a screen taller than 1180 pixels, it loads 100 rows. Select a page size at the bottom to load more rows.

The list updates when another user changes a document. It also reloads every 5 minutes while it is open. Turn off live updates with Disable Auto Refresh in list settings.

docs.title: List menu
docs.text:
Click ... to open the list menu.

Item Shows for What it does Refresh All users Loads the list again. Import Users who can import the DocType Opens Data Import for this DocType. User Permissions System Manager Opens the User Permission list for this DocType. Role Permissions Manager System Manager Opens the permissions of this DocType. Customize (Ctrl+J) Users who can create Custom Field and Property Setter Opens Customize Form, or the DocType form for a custom DocType. Toggle Sidebar (Ctrl+K) All users Hides or shows the sidebar. Edit DocType System Manager in developer mode Opens the DocType form. List Settings System Manager Opens List settings.

docs.title: List settings
docs.text:
List Settings changes the list for all users of the DocType. It saves a List View Settings document named after the DocType.

Field Label What it does total_fields Maximum Number of Fields The number of columns, from 4 to 10. fields Fields The columns of the list. Click + Add / Remove Fields to change them. disable_count Disable Count Hides the total count. disable_comment_count Disable Comment Count Hides the comment count in rows. disable_sidebar_stats Disable Sidebar Stats Removes the Tags dropdown from the sidebar. disable_auto_refresh Disable Auto Refresh Stops live updates of the list. allow_edit Allow Bulk Editing Allows bulk Edit and Delete when the DocType has a workflow. disable_automatic_recency_filters Disable Automatic Recency Filters Stops the 90 day filter on large tables.

docs.title: Keyboard shortcuts
docs.text: Shortcut Action Down / Up Move to the next or previous row. Shift+Down / Shift+Up Select rows while you move. Space Select the current row. Enter Open the current row. Ctrl+J Open Customize. Ctrl+K Hide or show the sidebar.

docs.title: For developers
docs.text:
• Change the list of a DocType in <doctype>_list.js next to the DocType JSON. It sets frappe.listview_settings["Sample Order"] with keys such as add_fields, filters, get_indicator, onload, button, formatters, primary_action, hide_name_column and hide_name_filter. Another app extends it with the doctype_list_js hook. frappe/desk/form/meta.py loads both. Refer to List view settings.
  • The columns come from fields with in_list_view. Standard filters come from fields with in_standard_filter. The default sort comes from sort_field and sort_order on the DocType.
  • The list gets its rows from frappe.desk.reportview.get. Bulk delete calls frappe.desk.reportview.delete_items. Bulk submit, cancel and edit call frappe.desk.doctype.bulk_update.bulk_update.submit_cancel_or_update_docs.
  • The large table check is Meta.check_if_large_table() in frappe/model/meta.py. It sets is_large_table on the meta.

docs.title: Search
docs.text: The desk has three ways to search. Use the awesomebar to open a page or start a new document. Use global search to find text in documents of many DocTypes. Use the list view filters to find documents of one DocType.

docs.title: Awesomebar
docs.text:
The awesomebar is the search box in the navbar (Search or type a command). Press Ctrl+G, or click the box, to use it. Type at least two characters. Use Up and Down to select a result and Enter to open it. Hold Ctrl while you select a result to open it in a new tab.

You type You get A DocType name, for example sample order Sample Order List and other matching DocTypes. new and a DocType, for example new sample New Sample Order. It opens a new document. A text, in and a DocType, for example customer a in sample order Find customer a in Sample Order. It opens the list filtered by that text. A report, page, workspace or dashboard name Report ..., Open ... (pages and workspaces) or ... Dashboard. A calculation, for example = 12 * 4 or 12*4 The result. Text with random Generate Random Password. # and a tag, for example #urgent Documents with that tag. Any other text Search for .... It opens global search.

On a list view, the awesomebar also offers Find ... in ... for the current DocType. Select Help on Search to see these rules in a dialog.

With an empty box, the awesomebar shows your recent pages.

Turn off the awesomebar for a user with Search Bar (search_bar) on the User.

For developers

Add results with the awesomebar_search hook. Each method gets txt and returns a list of dicts with label, route and optional description, index and route_options. The desk calls frappe.desk.search.awesomebar_search and shows the first 20 results of each method.

docs.title: Global search
docs.text:
Global search finds text in the fields of many DocTypes at the same time.

  1. Type a text in the awesomebar.
  2. Select Search for .... The search dialog opens.
  3. Click a DocType in the dialog sidebar to see results of that DocType only. Click All Results to see all DocTypes. Click More under a DocType to load more results.
  4. Click a result to open the document.

To match more than one term, join the terms with &, for example Customer A&Laptop. Start with # to search by tag.

Global search shows only documents that you can read.

docs.title: What global search finds
docs.text:
• Only DocTypes in Global Search Settings > Search Priorities (allowed_in_global_search). The order of the table is the order of the results.
  • Only fields with In Global Search (in_global_search) set. Set it in the DocType or in Customize Form. Fields of child tables also count.
  • The document name too, if the DocType has Make "name" searchable in Global Search (show_name_in_global_search).
  • Not cancelled documents, and not documents with disabled set or enabled not set.

When you save a document, the desk puts its text in a queue. A scheduled job (frappe.utils.global_search.sync_global_search) writes the queue to the __global_search table every 15 minutes. A new or changed document can take up to 15 minutes to show in the results.

For developers

An app adds its DocTypes to the default search priorities with the global_search_doctypes hook. The hook is a dict keyed by domain, for example {"Default": [{"doctype": "Sample Item"}]}. Set disable_global_search in site_config.json to stop indexing. The search API is frappe.utils.global_search.search(text, start, limit, doctype). Refer to Site config.

docs.title: Search in a list
docs.text:
In the list view, type in the standard filters at the top. The ID filter and text filters match a part of the value. Click Filter to search in any field.

In Link fields, type to search the linked DocType. The search uses the name, the title field and the Search Fields of the linked DocType.

docs.title: Tags
docs.text:
Tags are labels that users add to documents. To find documents by tag:

  • Type # and the tag in the awesomebar or in global search.
  • In the list view sidebar, open the Tags dropdown and select a tag.

Refer to Collaboration.

docs.title: Full-text search for apps
docs.text: Frappe also has a full-text search framework based on SQLite FTS5 in frappe/search/sqlite_search.py. The desk search does not use it. An app makes a subclass of SQLiteSearch, lists it in the sqlite_search hook, and builds its own search UI and API on it. Frappe keeps the index current with document events and scheduled jobs in frappe/hooks.py.

docs.title: Related
docs.text:
• Desk
  • List view
